WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT p.birth_country, COUNT(DISTINCT pc.player_id) as player_count
  FROM player_college pc 
  JOIN player p ON pc.player_id = p.player_id
  GROUP BY p.birth_country
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT SUM(player_count) as total_players
  FROM step1
),
step3 AS (
  SELECT s1.birth_country, s1.player_count, 
         CAST(s1.player_count AS REAL) / s2.total_players as proportion
  FROM step1 s1, step2 s2
  WHERE s2.total_players IS NOT NULL
),
step4 AS (
  SELECT AVG(proportion) as avg_proportion
  FROM step3
),
step5 AS (
  SELECT s3.birth_country, s3.player_count, s3.proportion,
         s3.player_count - s4.avg_proportion as diff
  FROM step3 s3, step4 s4
  WHERE s4.avg_proportion IS NOT NULL
  AND s3.player_count > s4.avg_proportion
)
SELECT SUM(player_count) as sum_counts,
       AVG(proportion) as avg_proportion,
       AVG(diff) as avg_diff
FROM step5
